## Before review

- [ ] **If this revises a merged design proposal:** it adds a decision record under that proposal's `decisions/` directory, or says below why none is needed.

<!-- A revision that changes a proposal's design carries reasoning — an
     approach that failed, a constraint you hit, an alternative you picked
     instead. Editing the proposal alone loses it: the revised text reads
     as though it always said the current thing.

     Not every revision needs a record. Wording fixes, corrections of
     fact, and decisions the code and its tests already explain do not.
     Say which it is; that sentence is the whole check.

     See design-proposals/README.md#decision-records. -->

## DCO

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit --signoff`).
